title: bug(faiss): list() returns bare [] for uninitialized index, breaking the List[List[OutputData]] contract
author: Bartok9

comments.author: kartik-mem0
comments.body:
## Triage Notes

**What we've established:**
- `FAISS.list()` in `mem0/vector_stores/faiss.py` returns `[results]` on initialized paths but a bare `[]` when `self.index is None`, breaking the `List[List[OutputData]]` contract.
- On a fresh FAISS store, `Memory.delete_all()` raises `IndexError: list index out of range` when indexing `[0]` on that bare `[]` — so deleting from an empty/uninitialized store fails instead of being a clean no-op.
- Same bug class as MongoDB (#5728), OpenSearch (#5726), and the previously fixed Pinecone error path (#5701/#5706).

**Reproduction:** Confirmed (code tracing; reproducer in the issue body works with zero external services)
**Root cause:** The uninitialized-index early-return in `FAISS.list()` needs to return `[[]]` instead of `[]` to match the contract all callers rely on.

**Next step:** PR #5725 addresses this — review feedback will be posted there.
